description: This file is a shell script used for testing the functionality of reverse index features in Git, including packing, indexing, verification, and corruption detection. It contains test setups, test cases, and utility functions to validate reverse index behavior.

methods.name: test_index_pack
methods.description: A utility function to test creating an index pack with different reverse index configurations and verify their existence.

methods.name: corrupt_rev_and_verify
methods.description: Function to corrupt specific parts of the reverse index file and verify that 'git fsck' detects the corruption.
